summary: verdaccio-tarball-local-storage preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript payload (shuffled string/number array, indexer function, single-letter identifiers, custom character decoder) with no readable code paths in source form. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: an alien runtime is fetched at install time and used to execute an opaque bundled payload on the installer's machine, bypassing Node-based inspection. The package presents itself as a fork of @verdaccio/local-storage (a Verdaccio storage plugin), a use case that has no need for a bundled Bun runtime; the Verdaccio plugin surface in dist/index.js is a thin benign-looking shim while the install-time behavior is the actual effect. Running `npm install` on this package therefore executes attacker-controlled, unreadable code on the installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
